scope: Manual/held-out audit of the automatically generated Palomar-Music-Genesis hidden-machine constellation before any candidate is treated as a real hidden machine.

mechanism: operator_event searches every configured signal and assigns the event position to the earliest occurrence of any hit
different operators share generic signals such as hash, sha256, context, exact, open, pass and change
two or more operators can therefore receive the same earliest character position
events are sorted by (position, operator_name), so equal-position events acquire a deterministic lexical order
machine_windows consumes the sorted operator names and can emit the resulting lexical tie-break as an ordered machine
defect.observed_evidence: The highest-scoring Palomar-Music-Genesis candidate contains multiple provenance documents whose machine_normalized_positions are identical for all three operators, e.g. [0.02193975, 0.02193975, 0.02193975] and [0.00701663, 0.00701663, 0.00701663].
defect.consequence: operator_order_required=true is not yet equivalent to semantic or textual strict order. A candidate may survive because co-located shared vocabulary was alphabetically ordered rather than because the document instantiates O1 -> O2 -> O3.

EYE-R3-TRIPLE-245e565b907b65ca.reason: Repeated equal normalized positions demonstrate that the current evidence does not establish ordered composition.

EYE-R3-TRIPLE-36e73df7576fe4db.reason: Some lineages show separated positions, but operator specificity is zero and shared-context vocabulary can still generate pseudo-order.

EYE-R3-TRIPLE-a3a348e0bd3a05ef.reason: Candidate is structurally plausible but still uses highly overlapping hash/identity/recovery vocabulary.

EYE-R3-TRIPLE-deea70afb1512e33.reason: Two Genesis and two Music lineages contain a meaningful provenance -> transition -> claim/identity-boundary narrative, but sampled Palomar lineages often trigger EXACT_VS_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY through exact/hash/sha256 vocabulary without an explicit semantic-identity contrast.

required_fix.strict_order: A machine window must require strictly increasing evidence anchors O1 < O2 < ... < On; equal positions are forbidden.
required_fix.shared_signal_decontamination: Ordering anchors should prefer operator-discriminative signals instead of generic signals shared by many operators.
required_fix.semantic_minimum: An operator may not be credited solely by generic hash/state/context boilerplate when its claimed invariant is more specific.
required_fix.negative_control: Reordered/shuffled operator controls must be run; a true ordered machine should outperform matched reordered controls.
required_fix.authority: All pre-fix R3 target candidates remain CANDIDATE_ONLY and must be re-mined/reverified after the stricter gate.

verdict: RUN-002 succeeds as a self-falsification run: the current Palomar-Music-Genesis constellation is not promoted, because the order detector itself admits a false-order pathway.
